Packaging display box check update 


 


Upon inspecting the flow-wrapped units (supplied in display packs) and the display packs themselves (supplied in cases), I found the flow-wrapped units to be well-sealed and neatly presented. The display packs are also well-sealed, with the contents neatly arranged; each display contains 24 units, and there are 12 displays per case. The printing on both the flow-wrapped units and the display packs is clear and correctly positioned according to product specifications. A vacuum test was also performed using the air-pressure tester; out of the 10 units tested, three showed an air bubble, while the others were securely sealed at both ends.

Team,
 
Please see the latest update regarding the L2 VFFS Affogato to Salted Caramel changeover.
 
Production Status
At the start of 3rd shift, we show approximately 995K pieces of Affogato WIP, which is enough to produce roughly 6,930 cases. Based on current inventory levels and an average production rate of approximately 3,000 cases per shift, the changeover to Salted Caramel 5-Count is currently projected to occur during 2nd shift on 7/30.
 
The plan is to run approximately 11 pallets before completing the changeover. However, this timing could move up if 3rd and 1st shifts exceed the current 3,000-case-per-shift average.
 
Note: The Final Daily Schedule and Visual Schedule have not yet been updated to reflect this projected changeover timing.
 
WIP Inventory
We are currently showing 9 pallets of Affogato WIP in NS at LN:

6 pallets are already in the LN-to-LW-B flow.3 older lots (1-63L and 2-63N) still need to be transferred during day shift.
Luis - Please ensure these older lots are sent to LW first thing during day shift so we can maintain the proper inventory flow and consume the oldest material first.
 
Because WIP has been moved out of FIFO sequence, we will need to complete four lot changes tomorrow to fully consume the remaining Affogato inventory.
